description: Return the formulas the connected project can use for testdata generation — DEFAULT prefabs (FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, COUNTRY_NAME, EMAIL_ID, PHONE_NUMBER, …) plus any CUSTOM formulas defined at customer or project scope. EVERY line starts with the NAME to pass as `name`; the parenthesised part after it is the human signature (it can differ — e.g. the name is EMAIL_ID while its signature reads EMAIL(...)), and `args:` lists the argument keys the formula accepts (matched case-insensitively). Feed a chosen `{name, args}` into `tc_generate_testdata.formulas` and that column is auto-filled fresh per row by the agent's formula engine. Use this when the user says "use a formula" / "generate an email" / "first name, phone, country…" / "list formulas".
name: tc_list_formulas
title: List testdata formulas available in the current project
